description: Galyk wears a dark blue knee-length wool tunic with narrow pale geometric woven borders at the split neckline and hem over an ivory linen underlayer visible at cuffs and lower hem. A heavy brown open-front wool outer coat has restrained pale geometric borders around the front and cuffs. A plain brown leather belt with a rectangular buckle and long hanging end secures the tunic. Brown trousers, wrapped lower legs with crossed ties and brown leather shoes complete the outfit. His short bowl-cut hair is uncovered.
